content.text:
Implemented a robust no-API fallback path so the app continues producing useful AI responses even when external providers are missing, unsynced, or failing.

1. Added `OfflineLLM` integration import and availability flag in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L50-L71).
2. Added local fallback method `_si_local_fallback_response(...)` in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6951-L6973) that uses `OfflineLLM` first, then falls back to existing `_generate_intelligent_response(...)`.
3. Hardened `_si_call_ai(...)` in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6975-L7060) so all failure modes now degrade to local fallback instead of returning hard error strings:
   1. Missing provider libs.
   2. Missing API keys.
   3. Missing Azure endpoint/deployment config.
   4. Runtime API exceptions.
4. Updated `_get_gpt_response(...)` in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7791-L7804) to always call unified path and return local fallback if remote output is empty.
5. Updated `_si_has_ai()` in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6917-L6934) to treat local fallback engines as valid AI availability.
6. Updated intelligent chat routing in [`HadesAI.py`](file:///c%3A/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7550-L7565) so complex/security prompts still use `_get_gpt_response(...)` (which now includes robust fallback), even without API keys.

Validation:
1. `python -m py_compile HadesAI.py offline_llm.py local_ai_response.py fallback_llm.py` passed.
2. `python verify_fallback_llm.py` passed (5/5).
3. `python test_llm_integration.py` still shows an existing file-lock issue on cleanup (`test_conversations.db` on Windows), but all core LLM/fallback integration checks passed before that cleanup step.
